help.title: Where the image lives
help.storage: The image lives in your library's Artwork folder, under the artist's own name — readable and copyable, while the Music folder stays exactly as beets filed it.
help.display: It is stored as a 500 px square and drawn as the artist's disc everywhere: the artists shelf, this page, the compact bar.

empty.title: Your library is empty
empty.body: Paste a link from Downloads, or import a folder you already have: everything that enters the ark is filed here.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.reenrichFailed: Match failed, try again in a moment.
metadata.bonusFrom: Bonus track from “{{source}}”, filed with the main album.

artistPair.title: One files it, the other describes it
artistPair.albumArtist: The name the album is filed under: it groups the tracks together and puts the album on that artist's page. Use the main artist, even when some tracks have guests.
artistPair.artist: Who plays this particular track, guests included. This is what playback shows and what search looks at.
artistPair.example: The album stays filed under “{{artist}}” even when a track is played by “{{artist}} feat. …”.

help.genre: The track's style, as written in the file — the precise genre, not the broad family.
help.genreBucket: The family Sonarche files this genre under for browsing. Computed automatically, and it doesn't count toward completion.
help.category: What this album is: music, a game soundtrack, a film score… It keeps soundtracks apart from the rest when browsing. Leaving it empty doesn't hurt completion.
help.track: The track's position in the album: this is what sets playback order. Two tracks sharing a number end up in an arbitrary order.
help.completion: The share of this album's metadata fields already filled. Optional fields are left out of it.
help.rematch: Re-runs the automatic identification: Sonarche queries MusicBrainz again from the files' acoustic fingerprint and rewrites the tags it recognises. Do this before your manual corrections, not after.
help.rematchCollection: This track sits in a collection — your own selection. Re-identifying would send it back to its original record, so it stays off here.

metadata.saveFailed: Save failed, try again in a moment.
metadata.soundtrackHint: MusicBrainz marks this release a soundtrack — pick a category.

kind.label: What this record is
kind.albumWhy: A release, with its tracklist: Sonarche flags the tracks it is missing and offers to identify it on MusicBrainz.
kind.collectionWhy: Your own gathering of tracks. No tracklist to live up to: no more missing-track flags, and the alignment leaves it alone.

common.heading: What holds for the whole album

tracks.filedUnder: Filed under {{artist}} — the Artist column says who plays each title.

bulk.heading: Across the record
bulk.renumberHelp: Rewrites the track numbers 1 to {{count}}, in the order shown.
bulk.copyArtistHelp: Offers to write the album artist onto the tracks — you pick which, and featurings start unticked.

mixed.hint_one: The tracks disagree here. Leave it empty to change nothing, or type a value to write it to the track.
mixed.hint_other: The tracks disagree here. Leave it empty to change nothing, or type a value to write it to all {{count}} tracks.

artist.prompt: You changed “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”. Which other tracks follow?
artist.fillPrompt: Write “{{to}}” to which tracks? Tracks already carrying another artist are left unticked — that is usually a featuring.

guard.title: Discard your changes?
guard.body_one: {{count}} change has not been written yet. Closing now loses it.
guard.body_other: {{count}} changes have not been written yet. Closing now loses them.

albumMetadata.saveFailedSafe: No file was touched — your changes are kept.

rematch.blocked: Unavailable while changes are pending — a re-match would overwrite the tags.
rematch.collection: Off for a collection: your own selection has no MusicBrainz release to look up, and re-identifying would send each track back to its original record.
rematch.confirmBodyTrack: Sonarche will query MusicBrainz again from the track's acoustic fingerprint and rewrite every tag it recognises — including the ones you fixed by hand.
rematch.confirmBodyAlbum: Sonarche will query MusicBrainz again from each track's acoustic fingerprint and rewrite every tag it recognises — including the ones you fixed by hand.
rematch.confirmSkipWhere: The confirmation can be turned back on in Settings → Metadata.
rematch.failed: The re-match failed — try again in a moment.

albumMetadata.provisionalCover: The cover is the video's thumbnail, not real artwork — replace it once you have the media's own image.

cover.title: Replace the cover
cover.drop: Drop or paste ({{chord}}) an image here, or click to choose a file
cover.reframeHint: Move the frame, or zoom, to choose the square that stays.
cover.notSquare: The frame runs past the picture — the cover would not come out square. Zoom back in until it fits inside.
cover.currentEmbedded_one: Embedded in {{count}} track — {{total}} in the file.
cover.currentEmbedded_other: Embedded in {{count}} tracks — ≈ {{total}} across the album.
cover.nextEmbedded_one: Will be embedded at ≈ {{each}} in {{count}} track.
cover.nextEmbedded_other: Will be embedded at ≈ {{each}} × {{count}} tracks — ≈ {{total}} across the album.
cover.nextEmbeddedUnknown_one: Will be embedded at 500 px in {{count}} track.
cover.nextEmbeddedUnknown_other: Will be embedded at 500 px in {{count}} tracks.
cover.candidateNote: From the Cover Art Archive: the full-size upload is downloaded, archived (cover-hq) and embedded at 500 px.
cover.tooSmall: Smaller than the 500 px display size — it will be used as-is, but may look soft.
cover.failed: The replacement failed — try again in a moment.

help.title: What replacing the cover writes
help.embed: Audio files carry their cover inside the file itself — that's how other players and devices show it. Sonarche embeds the image into each track of the album.
help.weight: The embedded copy is capped at 500×500 px. That's the whole point: a 3000×3000 scan embedded as-is would add several MB to every single track, where the 500 px rendition adds a few dozen KB.
help.archive: Your full image isn't lost: it's archived once next to the album (cover-hq) and stays available the day a full-size view needs it.

candidates.heading: Online proposals
candidates.hint: From the Cover Art Archive, via the album's MusicBrainz identification.
candidates.empty: No online proposal for this album.

imageUrl.failed: The link didn't return a readable image.

delete.title: Delete this track?
delete.body: “{{title}}” will be removed from your library and its file deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.

deleteAlbum.title: Delete this album?
deleteAlbum.body_one: “{{title}}” and its track will be removed from your library and the file deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.
deleteAlbum.body_other: “{{title}}” and its {{count}} tracks will be removed from your library and the files deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.
deleteAlbum.lockedTitle: A download is filing into this album
deleteAlbum.lockedBody: Tracks are on their way to this record. Wait for the download to finish — or stop it from Downloads — before deleting it.

move.newArtistPlaceholder: Artist (the folder to file it under)

move.confirmBody_one: The file joins the “{{name}}” folder on disk. The track's artist, genre and year stay as they are.
move.confirmBody_other: All {{count}} files join the “{{name}}” folder on disk. Each track's artist, genre and year stay as they are.
move.asCollectionHint: A personal gathering rather than a release: Sonarche stops counting its missing tracks, and arrivals are numbered onward.
move.alreadyCollection: “{{name}}” is a collection: arrivals are numbered onward.
move.undoneToast: Move undone — every track is back home.
move.undoFailedToast: The move could not be undone.
move.addTracksSubtitle: Picked tracks leave their record for this one.
move.addTracksSearchPlaceholder: Search a track, an artist, an album…
move.selectHint: Tick the tracks to bring in here.
